A swivel-mounted, anti-infantry ballista, loaded with three greatbolts. These siege engines are designed to fire projectiles as large as spears at enemy combatants, dealing heavy damage and knocking their targets to the ground. Various Lordsworn armies employed them during the Shattering to defend key positions, such as Stormveil Castle and Fort Haight.

records.description:
are enemies in Elden Ring and Shadow of the Erdtree.
==Overview== 
The stone sentries are bizarre, ominous creatures made from living rock. Their cylindrical, tube-like bodies are long chains of rounded stones bound together by gravitational energy. A crater in the topmost rock bears a single eye. They enjoy crawling around like earthworms, and are typically passive. At night, their eyes beam bright purple light as they keep active watch over the Evergaols in silence.
